full_text_tesim: The texts of Ecclesiastes, Song of Songs and Wisdom of Solomon belong to the same original manuscript. Folios once belonging to this text are also found in the undertext of Sinai Georgian NF M 13 ("Works of Solomon"). This was most probably a manuscript containing only the "Bankʿ Sołomoni"

The undertext folio order includes the erased Armenian texts of Ecclesiastes, Song of Songs and Wisdom of Solomon, because these all belonged to the same original manuscript. References to Sin. geo. NF 13 included to show the original sequence
